listing.name: Lion's Guard Extras (26/5/2025)
listing.summary: Adds two new Lion's Guard ships with unique weapon systems and a new mission to test one of them.

description:
Lion's Guard Extras

Requires

LazyLib.

(For

Starsector 0.98-RC8

)

Description

Motivated by a combo of the "What happened to Andrada's Hegemony ships?" thread and the "The LG need another capital" thread...

Adds two new ships to the Lion's Guard fleet:

Conquest Mk II (LG): The front missile hardpoints removed, replaced with a built-in Thermal Pulse Cannon salvaged from Andrada's Hegemony fleet and upgraded by Tri-Tachyon, with some flashy FX. The ship system is replaced with High-Energy Focus. A flux-management challenge, but has the potential for incredible first-strike.
Champion (LG): The front missile hardpoint switched to Energy.

Both use incredible art from

King Alfonzo

. Also used in the Ship & Weapon Pack, but I wanted to do the custom flashy FX.

Also adds a mission,

A Momentary Triumph

, where you can test the Conquest Mk II (LG) (formally named the

Triumph

by the Diktat) against an Independent mercenary sent to recover weapons test data for Tri-Tachyon.

Enjoy, and let me know if the Conquest Mk II (LG) is

too

jank to work properly.

Installation

Download via the link or going to GitHub and getting the latest

.zip

from the Releases list, extract the

starsector-lg-extra

directory, and place it in your starsector/mods directory then check it in the launcher.
descriptionHtml:
Lion's Guard Extras
 
Requires LazyLib.
(For Starsector 0.98-RC8)

Description
Motivated by a combo of the "What happened to Andrada's Hegemony ships?" thread and the "The LG need another capital" thread...

Adds two new ships to the Lion's Guard fleet:
  • Conquest Mk II (LG): The front missile hardpoints removed, replaced with a built-in Thermal Pulse Cannon salvaged from Andrada's Hegemony fleet and upgraded by Tri-Tachyon, with some flashy FX. The ship system is replaced with High-Energy Focus. A flux-management challenge, but has the potential for incredible first-strike.
  • Champion (LG): The front missile hardpoint switched to Energy.
Both use incredible art from King Alfonzo. Also used in the Ship & Weapon Pack, but I wanted to do the custom flashy FX.

Also adds a mission, A Momentary Triumph, where you can test the Conquest Mk II (LG) (formally named the Triumph by the Diktat) against an Independent mercenary sent to recover weapons test data for Tri-Tachyon.

Enjoy, and let me know if the Conquest Mk II (LG) is too jank to work properly.

Installation
Download via the link or going to GitHub and getting the latest .zip from the Releases list, extract the starsector-lg-extra directory, and place it in your starsector/mods directory then check it in the launcher.
